Began OK. Pushed fwd & shared lead on inside early . Stayed =lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken @ 500m. Pressured =lead on inside on home turn. Headed @ 300m & weakened in straight. Vetted clear. # On-pace/weakened
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance, rdr confirmed that his instructions were to lead in accordance with its recent racing pattern. He added that when challenged in the lead throughout the middle stages his mount completed significant work resulting in it weakening in the straight and with hindsight he felt that he should have eased his mount in the middle stages and taken a position behind the leaders which would have provided a better chance of finishing off its race. A post-race vet exam did not reveal any abs.
